name: Piper PA-28-181 Archer II

_sources.vr: Sec 5.2 Flaps-up takeoff chart: lift-off speed 53 KIAS at 2550 lb
_sources.vy: Sec 4.2: best rate of climb 76 KIAS
_sources.glide: Sec 5.11 Glide Range chart: power off, flaps up, 76 KIAS, 2550 lb; example 13 NM at 8,000 ft minus 2.5 NM at 1,500 ft = 10.5 NM for 6,500 ft -> L/D about 9.8
_sources.stall: Sec 4.19: gross-weight stall power off, full flaps 49 KIAS; flaps up is 6 kt higher = 55 KIAS (normal takeoff is flaps up, so 55 is used for the takeoff-flap entry too)

_missing: Climb rate at 76 KIAS (the POH only gives a time-to-climb chart)
Takeoff ground roll (the POH charts give distance over a 50 ft barrier only; you can enter that instead)
Landing ground roll (POH gives distance over a 50 ft barrier only; you can enter that instead)
